description: Custom schema for mono repo root package.json script descriptions.

ws.description:
Execute a command inside a workspace.

Usage: `yarn ws "@mono/regex" "build"`

clean.description: Runs all clean tasks: fixOwnWsImports, indexts, ensureVitestImports, removeEmptyWsFiles, replaceBadDashChars.

clean:fixOwnWsImports.description: Fixes import statements where a path alias is used to reference its own workspace (can cause build problems due to circular references).

clean:indexts.description: Generate barrel export files at src/index.ts (runs script defined in each workspace package.json).

clean:ensureVitestImports.description: Ensures that all test files have the necessary Vitest imports.

clean:removeEmptyWsFiles.description: Removes any files that have size 0 bytes for all workspaces.

clean:replaceBadDashChars.description: Replaces bad dash characters (em dash U+2014) with regular hyphens in all workspace files.

insight.description: Runs all insight tasks: knip, filesWithMissingCoverage, linesOfCode.

insight:knip.description: Runs knip to find unused exports, dependencies, and files.

insight:filesWithMissingCoverage.description: Lists files with incomplete code coverage.

insight:checkLibsTsDoc.description: Validates TSDoc documentation for all library exports.

insight:linesOfCode.description: Counts lines of code across the monorepo by category.

docs.description: Generates and writes the README.md file with auto-generated documentation.

lint.description: Runs eslint on all workspaces with auto-fix.

format.description: Formats all files in the monorepo using prettier.

typecheck.description: Runs tsc typecheck on all workspaces (noEmit).

test.description:
Run vitest normally without coverage or watch mode.

Usage: `yarn test` or `yarn test <glob>`

test:watch.description: Run vitest in watch mode without coverage.

test-coverage.description: Run vitest on all workspaces and emit coverage (html, json summary) for workspaces in libs/ dir.

test-coverage:open.description: Open the coverage index html file with OS default app.

precommit.description: Runs all pre-commit checks: install, clean, typecheck, lint, build, test-coverage, docs, format, insight.

DK.description: Run devkit CLI (apps/devkit) without building first.
